posts.title: Squash Hunt
posts.headline: Seattle · 星期日亲子精选
highlights: 🎉 可以体验节庆与社区主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: Experience the magic of autumn at Bloedel Reserve. Wander the trails surrounded by brilliant fall color as you join our Annual Squash Hunt. Pick up a map and search for decorative squash tucked throughout the gardens. Young explorers can grab a Passport from the Arrival Garden. With it in hand, kids can stop at our new destinations signs along the way and create rubbings of each destination to complete their fall adventure. Don’t miss the Sheep Sheds—climb into the hay bales, pose for fun photos, and challenge friends to pumpkin tic-tac-toe or checkers. Stop by the Residence to guess the weight of the giant pumpkin. Join us for pumpkin painting during our Fall Harvest Celebration on October 3 (11–4 PM) or Welcome Wednesday October 7 (1–4 PM). Your masterpiece will be entered in our Pumpkin Contest—entries will be displayed all month long, with voting beginning October 8. The winner receives their choice of six guest admission passes or a complimentary Friends & Family Membership. All Squash Hunt activities are included with the price of admission. Timed tickets are recommended. WHERE Pick up your map and passport in the Arrival Garden. WHEN Sept. 29 – Nov. 1

posts.title: Red Barn Farm Fall Festival
posts.headline: Bellevue · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: Fall is just around the corner, and that means it’s time for our favorite tradition of the year! Join us at The Red Barn Farm in Redmond, WA for our 8th Annual Fall Festival, a family-friendly celebration full of autumn charm, exciting activities, and memories waiting to be made. When: Every October weekend: Saturdays & Sundays! Where: 5703 208th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98053 Duration: 3 Hours | Last entry at 3:00 PM (activities end at 4 PM) Ticket Pricing Adults: $12 Children (Ages 1–17): $20 (includes 1 feed bag to feed the animals!) Infants (Under 1): Free Add-Ons U-Pick Flowers: $25-35 (includes vase + fill it with flowers of your choice) U-Pick Pumpkins: Traditional varieties at $0.58/lb | Specialty varieties at $0.89/lb Extra Feed Bags: can be purchased on site with all proceeds donated to our non-profit Gem Mining: This year, our nonprofit is excited to host a gem mining fundraiser! Discover crystals, shark teeth, fossils, gems, and more at this activity booth! Tickets (in the form of donations) will be available for purchase on-site. S’mores What’s Included Your ticket includes access to all our favorite fall activities: Face Painting Adult Axe Throwing (Ages 13+) & Rubber Axe Throwing for kids Barrel Train Rides Petting Zoo Animal Feed Bags Chicken Poop Bingo Rubber Duck Races at Playground Giant Bubble Station Cow Roping (practice, not real!) Fall Crafts in the Barn Mini

highlights: 🎟️ 活动免费参加。📚 可以体验教育与探索主题活动。
posts.description: Hike with a Park Guide every Saturday starting from the Rhododendron Garden at 9 am. The walk will average 3 miles at a leisurely pace and can be tailored to participant interest and time for a different route each week. Free. No registration necessary. Participants should come prepared with water, snacks, appropriate attire for the weather, and any questions they may have for the Park Guide. Kids are welcome if accompanied by an adult. Please note the hike may be too long (up to 3 miles) for some children. Well-behaved dogs on leash are allowed. Hikers will navigate uneven, rocky and hilly trails. Image sourced from event website.

posts.description: Welcome to Fun Park @ Thomas Family Farm. Open every Saturday and Sunday 10am-6pm in October. Fun Park will keep everyone entertained, big and little alike. Sports toss, tire climb, duck races, playground and more! A Fall Family Farm event wouldn’t be complete without a Pumpkin Patch & Corn Maze. We increased path sizes to 8ft wide and decreased the distance to 2.1 miles. There is a halfway point where you can leave early once you reach that point. It will be muddy, wear sturdy footwear.

highlights: 🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: Named Washington State’s best pumpkin patch by “Readers Digest” in 2019, and more recently among the best pumpkin farms in the country (!), this farm is justifiably very popular, especially with younger kids. As the Snohomish Valley’s Original Pumpkin Patch, Craven Farm is a decades old tradition for many families. Continue your family tradition or start a new one this fall at Craven Farm! At Craven Farm, we’re dedicated to creating an enjoyable and memorable fall experience for everyone who visits us. Our farm offers an extensive range of activities to suit all age groups, including apple cannons and slingers, fair foods, espresso, and donuts. Our unique attractions like cow trains, wagon rides, multiple acres of themed corn mazes, jump pad & animals are sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Visit us today and make some unforgettable memories with us this fall! Check out our huge list of pumpkin extravaganzas happening this year.

highlights: 全家同乐的秋季农场乐园，运动投掷、轮胎攀爬、小鸭赛跑、游乐场等项目玩不停。149种南瓜、14万多个可挑选，南瓜地加玉米迷宫一次打卡。迷宫通道加宽、总长约2.1英里并设中途出口；场地可能泥泞，记得穿结实防滑鞋。
